entities.summary: Andreas Gustaf Engqvist is a Swedish former professional ice hockey centre who last played with Djurgårdens IF of the SHL, his second tenure with the club. He most recently played for Salavat Yulaev Ufa of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
